Tiny Keys

Every key does something. Letters say "A for Apple", numbers count ducks and balloons, the space bar brings real animal sounds, and Music mode turns the keyboard into a violin, veena or flute. Made for ages 1 to 3.

To stop: press and hold the moon button in the top corner for 3 seconds. Locking uses full screen; in Chrome and Edge it also captures shortcut keys, and holding Esc leaves full screen.
